items.name: fullstack-code-reviewer
items.summary: Reviews a module end to end, or the uncommitted changes before a commit — backend, frontend and the contract between them.

items.name: backend-code-reviewer
items.summary: Reviews server code: correctness, data isolation, authorization, security, database, API contract, tests.

items.name: frontend-code-reviewer
items.summary: Reviews client code: correctness, data fetching and cache, XSS and tokens, accessibility, UX states, tests.

items.name: data-isolation-reviewer
items.summary: Finds code that lets one user reach another user's records, or one customer see another customer's data.

items.name: review-findings-fixer
items.summary: Fixes a review's findings: checks each one, pushes back on wrong ones, fixes with a test. Never commits.

items.name: review-fix-loop
items.summary: /review-fix-loop — runs the reviewers you pick, has review-findings-fixer fix the findings, re-reviews, up to 3 rounds, with a report.
